desc: 腰贴粘合轻盈贴身、立体护围锁边、薄芯不臃肿，好动也不移位
name: 腰贴式轻盈贴身婴儿纸尿裤款

shots.intent: 首屏用干净底与产品完整形态在三秒内建立轻盈贴身的第一印象。
shots.textZone: top center headline in #34313A at 32pt reading 「轻盈贴身 一贴即合」, subtitle in #8E8397 at 18pt reading 「{selling_point_1}」

shots.intent: 把翻身好动时腰贴松动、护围外翻的尴尬摆上台面，制造更换诉求。
shots.textZone: upper left headline in #34313A at 32pt reading 「好动易移位」, two bracket-dot icons with labels in #C07A45 at 13pt reading 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 用同机位同光线的并排平铺，把腰贴结构与护围形态的差别讲成一眼可判断的对照。
shots.textZone: top center headline in #34313A at 32pt reading 「同机位同光线对比」, column pills in #C07A45 and #8E8397 at 14pt reading 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 把产品放回真实带娃日常，用有温度的抱姿场景降低戒备、放大好感。
shots.textZone: top left headline in #34313A at 32pt reading 「日常抱抱也不勒」, one bracket-dot icon with a label in #C07A45 at 13pt reading 「{callout_3}」

shots.intent: 用微距把腰贴粘合区讲清楚，支撑一贴即合又不割手的卖点。
shots.textZone: left edge labels in #34313A at 18pt reading 「{selling_point_2}」, one bracket-dot icon in #C07A45 beside it

shots.intent: 把弹性腰围与立体护围的构造拍实，让贴身不移位的说法有结构依据。
shots.textZone: left edge labels in #34313A at 18pt reading 「{selling_point_3}」 and 「{selling_point_4}」, each paired with a bracket-dot icon in #C07A45

shots.intent: 用成人托抱掌心的尺度参照与细腻纹理特写，传递可信的做工而不靠任何认证标。
shots.textZone: top center headline in #34313A at 32pt reading 「轻得像没穿」, subtitle in #8E8397 at 18pt reading 「{selling_point_5}」

shots.intent: 用三档并排的选择布局把决策收窄，把注意力和行动一并导向加购。
shots.textZone: top center headline in #34313A at 32pt reading 「按需选一档」, three bracket-dot icons with labels in #C07A45 at 13pt reading 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」, bottom center button in #C07A45 with copy in #F2EFE9 at 14pt reading 「先选一档试试」
